compiled_state.title: T1: GREEN — Audit and remove legacy feature flags
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Audit the codebase for legacy feature flag functions (boolean helpers that check config keys with deprecated 'true'/'false' pattern) and remove or migrate them to direct config key reads.

## Files to Audit
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh (current flag library)
- plugins/dso/scripts/ (any scripts calling removed flag helpers)
- plugins/dso/skills/ (any skills sourcing planning-config.sh)

## Audit Steps
1. List all is_*_enabled() / *_flag() style functions across plugin scripts
2. Classify each: active-needed, active-migrate-to-config-key, or legacy-dead-code
3. Remove dead-code flag functions; migrate live ones to direct read-config.sh calls

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -rn 'is_.*_enabled\|.*_flag()' plugins/dso/hooks/lib/ | wc -l → matches count of only still-needed flags
- All removed functions have callers updated or confirmed zero callers
- ruff check passes (no Python impact expected)

## Testing Mode
GREEN (audit + cleanup; prior art: planning-config.sh is the only current flag library)
